name: Abandoned Soviet Btr   80
axis_orientation: front-end is the muzzle/nose/bow, rear-end is the troop ramp/engine
operating_principle: The BTR-80 is an 8x8 wheeled amphibious armoured personnel carrier that uses its diesel engine to propel itself on land and water, providing protection and transportation for its crew and passengers.

components.description: The main structural body of the vehicle, providing protection and support for the crew and passengers.
The rotating structure that houses the main armament, providing protection and firepower for the crew.
The system that transmits power from the engine to the wheels, enabling the vehicle to move.
The components that make up the vehicle's wheeled suspension system, providing mobility and stability.
The system that connects the wheels to the hull, providing a smooth ride and stability.
The area that houses the passengers, providing protection and comfort.
The system that generates power for the vehicle, including the engine and transmission.
The components that provide visibility and situational awareness for the crew.
